# The Morning Upgrade

> The Morning Upgrade (themorningupgrades.com) sells one product in the United States: CoreJava, an instant coffee made by MarketPlace Global with MCT powder from coconut, natural caffeine and L-theanine among its ingredients (the full Supplement Facts panel is on the ingredients page). One level scoop in 8 fl oz of hot water makes a cup, and a bag holds 30 servings. The site is run by Rector & Stull LLC, an independent sales representative (ISR) of MarketPlace Global; Rector & Stull is not the manufacturer.

Facts as stated on the site (updated 2026-10-30):

- Price: $79.95 for one bag (30 servings), or $69.95 a month with Subscribe & Save (one bag every 30 days; pause, skip or cancel anytime from the receipt link).
- Serving: one level scoop, about 6.8 g, in 8 fl oz of hot water. 30 servings per 7.2 oz (204 g) bag. Dark roast; works black, with creamer or over ice.
- Caffeine: 100 mg of added natural caffeine per scoop, plus the instant coffee's own caffeine.
- Shipping: US addresses only, flat $8.95 per bag. Orders ship from Minnesota within about two business days, then 3-6 days in transit.
- Returns: the maker's 90-day money-back guarantee on unopened bags; damaged or incorrect items are replaced if reported within 30 days of delivery.
- Contains caffeine. For adults; not for children or anyone pregnant or nursing. Ask a physician first if you take medication or have a medical condition.
- Product copy quotes the label rather than adding claims of its own. The guides are general information, not medical advice.
- People shown in the site's videos are AI presenters, and the site says so.
- Contact: hello@themorningupgrades.com. Rector & Stull LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801.

## Guides

- [What Is MCT Coffee? MCT Oil vs. Powder](https://themorningupgrades.com/what-is-mct-coffee.html): MCT coffee is coffee with medium-chain triglycerides added, as an oil you blend in or a powder you stir in. What MCTs are and how oil and powder differ.
- [How to Make Instant MCT Coffee (One Scoop)](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-to-make-mct-instant-coffee.html): One level scoop in 8 fl oz of hot water, stirred until dissolved. Step by step, plus iced and latte-style versions and how to adjust the strength.
- [L-Theanine and Caffeine: Reading the Label](https://themorningupgrades.com/l-theanine-and-caffeine.html): L-theanine is the amino acid in tea leaves, often paired with caffeine. What the pairing is, how to read the label, and what small studies found.
- [MCT Coffee vs. Butter Coffee, Compared](https://themorningupgrades.com/mct-coffee-vs-butter-coffee.html): Butter coffee is coffee blended with butter and usually MCT oil; MCT coffee adds MCT oil or powder, no butter. How prep, texture and travel compare.
- [Iced Instant Coffee, No Clumps: 3 Recipes](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-instant-coffee-recipes.html): Dissolve hot, then go cold: the trick for smooth iced instant coffee, plus iced classic, iced oat vanilla and a blended frappé.
- [How Much Caffeine Is in Instant Coffee?](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-much-caffeine-in-instant-coffee.html): USDA data: about 62 mg in an 8 fl oz cup of instant coffee vs. about 95 mg brewed. What changes the number, and how to read a label.
- [How to Make Instant Coffee Taste Better](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-to-make-instant-coffee-taste-better.html): Six fixes for better instant coffee: water just off the boil, the right ratio, a paste first, a pinch of salt, milk, and keeping the jar dry.
- [Does Instant Coffee Go Bad? Storage Tips](https://themorningupgrades.com/does-instant-coffee-go-bad.html): Instant coffee goes stale rather than spoiling, but moisture can ruin it. What the date means, signs it's past its best, and how to store it.
- [Instant Coffee for Travel, Camping & Dorms](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-for-travel-camping-dorm.html): How to make good instant coffee away from a kitchen: what to pack, where to find hot water, cold-water backup and flying with coffee powder.
- [What Is MCT Powder? Powder vs. MCT Oil](https://themorningupgrades.com/what-is-mct-powder.html): MCT powder is MCT oil dried onto a carrier like acacia fiber, tapioca or milk protein. What's in it, how it compares to oil, and what to check.
- [Natural vs. Synthetic Caffeine Explained](https://themorningupgrades.com/natural-caffeine-vs-synthetic.html): Natural and synthetic caffeine are the same molecule; the label word tells you the source. Where each comes from and what to check on a label.
- [Caffeine and L-Theanine Ratio in Studies](https://themorningupgrades.com/caffeine-and-l-theanine-ratio.html): The caffeine and L-theanine doses small studies used, how to work out a product's ratio from its label, and what the research can't tell you.
- [Instant vs. Drip Coffee: Cost per Cup](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-vs-drip-cost-per-cup.html): How to work out cost per cup for instant, drip, pods and café coffee, with a calculator and the extras people forget to count.

## Recipes

- [Instant Coffee Recipes: Iced, Hot & Blended](https://themorningupgrades.com/recipes.html): Twelve drinks made with instant coffee: iced coffee, frappé, latte, mocha, cold foam, dalgona, affogato and more. Steps, times and tips for each.
- [Iced Instant Coffee Recipe (No Clumps)](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-instant-coffee-recipe.html): Iced instant coffee in two minutes: dissolve the coffee in a little hot water first, then pour over ice and top up. No clumps, no machine.
- [Iced Oat Milk Vanilla Coffee (Instant)](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-oat-milk-vanilla-coffee.html): An iced vanilla oat milk coffee made with instant coffee: a hot coffee base, ice, cold oat milk and one drop of vanilla. Ready in three minutes.
- [Instant Coffee Frappé Recipe (3 Minutes)](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-frappe.html): A blended coffee frappé with instant coffee, milk, ice and a little honey: how to get it thick and how to keep it from separating.
- [How to Make a Latte with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-latte.html): A latte with instant coffee: a strong instant coffee base topped with steamed or frothed milk. Stovetop, microwave and handheld-frother methods.
- [Mocha with Instant Coffee: Hot or Iced](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-mocha.html): A mocha made with instant coffee and cocoa powder: dissolve both in a little hot water, then add hot or cold milk. Hot and iced versions.
- [Cinnamon Instant Coffee (No Grit)](https://themorningupgrades.com/cinnamon-instant-coffee.html): How to add cinnamon to instant coffee without a gritty cup: bloom it in the hot water, sweeten while hot, or use a cinnamon stick. Hot and iced.
- [Coffee Protein Shake with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-protein-shake.html): A blended coffee protein shake with instant coffee, milk, ice and a scoop of protein powder. How to keep it smooth and how to make it without a blender.
- [Coffee Ice Cubes from Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/coffee-ice-cubes.html): Coffee ice cubes keep iced coffee from going watery. How to make them from instant coffee, how long they keep, and three ways to use them.
- [Affogato with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-affogato.html): An affogato with instant coffee: a strong, small instant coffee poured hot over a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Two ingredients, two minutes.
- [Dalgona Whipped Coffee with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/dalgona-whipped-coffee.html): Dalgona whipped coffee: instant coffee, sugar and hot water whipped into a thick foam over milk. The ratio, the whisking time and a serving note.
- [Pumpkin Spice Coffee with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/pumpkin-spice-instant-coffee.html): A pumpkin spice latte at home with instant coffee: pumpkin purée, pumpkin pie spice, a little sugar and hot milk. Hot or iced, no syrup needed.
- [Coffee Cold Foam with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-cold-foam.html): Café-style cold foam at home: froth cold skim milk with a little sugar for 20 seconds and spoon it over iced instant coffee. Plain or vanilla.
